constraints.definition: CHECK ((((stage = 'bronze'::text) AND (threshold_tv = (1000)::numeric)) OR ((stage = 'silver'::text) AND (threshold_tv = (1500)::numeric)) OR ((stage = 'gold'::text) AND (threshold_tv = (2000)::numeric))))
